public_definitions: The task is to assess the dashboard view for the selected sentinel sites and choose the next review route for whether this evidence should be used to support a network-wide operational claim.
Option 1: Route for broader population review before advancing a network-wide claim.
Option 2: Advance a network-wide claim based on the displayed sentinel site pattern.
Option 3: File this sentinel site comparison as background reference.
uncertain: The chart displays only a subset of sites described as having the 'highest case loads,' so it is unclear whether this subset is representative of the entire network.
No statistical measures (e.g., confidence intervals, p-values, or trend significance) are provided to validate the observed pattern.
The relationship between testing volume and positive cases is shown as a simple scatter without a fitted line or correlation coefficient, making it difficult to confirm a causal or operational claim.
